activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Clearing breakfast dishes and loading the dishwasher
Setting up the home workspace, turning on the desk lamp and computer, reviewing the day's program schedule and emails
Working from home on the computer: coordinating community programs, drafting outreach materials and replying to partner emails
Taking a lunch break, heating food in the microwave and eating
Continuing work from home on the computer: hosting online coordination calls and updating program records
Logging off work, stretching and resting on the sofa
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and oven, then eating
Vacuuming the living room and tidying up after the day
Taking an evening shower and drying off
Relaxing with the TV and browsing on the phone
Winding down, dimming the desk lamp and getting ready for bed
